summary: Postinstall dependency-confusion beacon probing internal Twilio hosts and AWS IMDS, exfiltrating results to bintool.brkd.no
details: fmt-util-k7x2 advertises itself as a small string-formatting utility (index.js only exports pad/trim), but its package.json declares a postinstall hook (node setup.js) that automatically runs on npm install. setup.js probes reachability of internal Twilio infrastructure (stage.twilio.com, code.hq.twilio.com, twilio.jfrog.io, artifacts.twilio.com) and the AWS instance metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254), then transmits the per-target reachability results as URL query parameters over plain HTTP to an external, non-Twilio host at http://bintool.brkd.no/compat-check. The advertised purpose (string utilities) is unrelated to the network reconnaissance actually performed, and the beacon target is hardcoded and attacker-controlled. This is the canonical dependency-confusion reconnaissance shape: signal to an external endpoint when the package resolves inside a specific target's internal build environment or on AWS infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
